arXiv:2605.22738v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 5 月 21 日arXiv:2605.22738v1 [cs.LG] 21 May 2026

基于代理的近似Proxy-Based Approximation of
沙普利和班扎夫相互作用Shapley and Banzhaf Interactions

Santo M. A. R. Thies 1,2,3 Hubert Baniecki 4,5 R. Teal Witter 6
Eyke Hüllermeier 1,2,3 Maximilian Muschalik 1,2,†\dagger Fabian Fumagalli 1,2,7,†\dagger
1LMU Munich 2MCML 3DFKI 4Centre for Credible AI, Warsaw University of Technology
5University of Warsaw 6Claremont McKenna College 7Bielefeld University
摘要Abstract

Shapley 和 Banzhaf 的交互捕捉了现代机器学习应用中固有的复杂动态。然而，目前这些高阶相互作用的估计器在速度和准确性之间进行权衡。为了克服这个限制，我们引入了 ProxySHAP。 ProxySHAP 协调了基于树的代理模型的高样本效率与通过残差校正实现一致性的原则路径。在理论层面上，我们推导了介入 TreeSHAP 的多项式时间推广，以计算树集成的精确交互索引，成功绕过了先前方法中的指数树深度依赖性。此外，我们正式分析了残差调整策略，描述了最大样本重用（MSR）纠正代理偏差的具体条件，而其方差不随交互大小呈指数缩放。广泛的基准测试表明，ProxySHAP 为近似质量设定了新的最先进标准，包括在具有数千个功能的大型应用程序中。通过在小预算和大预算方案中实现最低误差，ProxySHAP 的性能显着优于之前的最佳估计器 ProxySPEX 和 KernelSHAP-IQ，同时还在下游可解释性任务中提供卓越的性能。Shapley and Banzhaf interactions capture the complex dynamics inherent in modern machine learning applications. However, current estimators for these higher-order interactions trade off between speed and accuracy. To overcome this limitation, we introduce ProxySHAP. ProxySHAP reconciles the high sample efficiency of tree-based proxy models with a principled path to consistency via residual correction. On a theoretical level, we derive a polynomial-time generalization of interventional TreeSHAP to compute exact interaction indices for tree ensembles, successfully bypassing exponential tree-depth dependencies in prior methods. Furthermore, we formally analyze the residual adjustment strategy, characterizing the specific conditions under which Maximum Sample Reuse (MSR) corrects proxy bias without its variance scaling exponentially with interaction size. Extensive benchmarking demonstrates that ProxySHAP sets a new state-of-the-art standard for approximation quality, including in large-scale applications with thousands of features. By achieving the lowest error in both small- and large-budget regimes, ProxySHAP significantly outperforms the prior best estimators ProxySPEX and KernelSHAP-IQ, while also delivering superior performance on downstream explainability tasks.

1 简介Introduction

随着人工智能越来越多地融入医疗保健和金融领域的关键决策流程，对透明度和可信度的需求从未如此之高。 为了解释这些模型通常不透明的动态，该领域已经围绕合作博弈论作为With the growing integration of artificial intelligence into critical decision-making processes across healthcare and finance, the demand for transparency and trustworthiness has never been higher. To interpret the often opaque dynamics of these models, the field has coalesced around cooperative game theory as the事实上的de facto标准standard[37, 41, 49, 42]。 具体来说，沙普利值. Specifically, Shapley values[53]和班扎夫值and Banzhaf values[3]，基本实例, fundamental instances of基数概率值cardinal-probabilistic values，为归因提供严格的公理框架。 这些概念在现代机器学习中无处不在，是特征归因等任务的基石, provide a rigorous axiomatic framework for attribution. These concepts are ubiquitous in modern machine learning, serving as the cornerstone for tasks such as feature attribution[55, 37]和数据评估and data valuation[49, 25].

1.1 估计基数概率相互作用Estimating Cardinal-Probabilistic Interactions

计算概率值和交互对于大型计算来说是令人望而却步的Computing probabilistic values and interactions is computationally prohibitive for largenn，因为它需要评估价值函数, as it requires evaluating the value functionν​(T)\nu(T)跨越所有across all2n2^{n}子集。因此，研究人员依靠使用固定评估预算生成估计值的算法。对于概率值，有许多估计器，例如蒙特卡洛采样subsets. Consequently, researchers rely on algorithms that produce estimates using a fixed evaluation budget. For probabilistic values, there are numerous estimators such as Monte Carlo sampling[56], 最大样品重复利用 (MSR), maximum sample reuse (MSR)[60], 排列采样, permutation sampling[7]，以及基于回归的方法，例如 KernelSHAP, and regression-based approaches like KernelSHAP[37, 10, 45].

虽然历史上很少，但最近关于估计概率的工作While historically sparse, recent work on estimating probabilistic互动interactions正在扩展以解释现代机器学习中固有的复杂的、高阶的依赖关系。然而，当前的估计器通常要么快速要么准确，但不能两者兼而有之。智商is expanding to explain the complex, higher-order dependencies inherent in modern machine learning. Yet, current estimators are generally either fast or accurate, but not both. SHAP-IQ[16]将 MSR 推广到相互作用，可以有效地计算，但出了名的不准确：它的方差与值函数的大小成二次方缩放，我们进一步发现了高阶相互作用的复合物。 相反，KernelSHAP-IQ 等回归方法generalizes MSR to interactions, being efficiently computable, but notoriously inaccurate: its variance scales quadratically with the value function’s magnitude, which we find compounds further for higher-order interactions. Conversely, regression approaches like KernelSHAP-IQ[17]是准确的，但需要不切实际的样本预算来充分拟合大量高阶项。 此外，KernelSHAP-IQ 的计算成本仍然很高，其时间复杂度依赖于are accurate but require impractical sample budgets to adequately fit the large number of higher-order terms. Additionally, KernelSHAP-IQ remains computationally expensive, suffering a quadratic time complexity dependence onnn.

为了规避这些瓶颈，最近的工作利用了代理模型To circumvent these bottlenecks, recent work leverages surrogate modelsν^\hat{\nu}近似to approximateν\nu [4, 63]。代理SPEX. ProxySPEX[4]从树代理中提取傅里叶系数，该系数随深度呈指数级扩展，因此需要进行激进的、损害准确性的截断。此外，即使具有精确的傅里叶系数，ProxySPEX 也会返回extracts Fourier coefficients from a tree surrogate, which scales exponentially with depth, necessitating aggressive, accuracy-compromising truncation. RegressionMSR[63]通过直接从树中提取值并使用 MSR 来估计残差值，优雅地解决了这个问题elegantly resolves this by directly extracting the values from the tree and employing MSR to estimate the residual values ofν−ν^\nu-\hat{\nu}。尽管它具有最先进的概率性能. Despite its state-of-the-art performance for probabilistic价值观values，RegressionMSR 仅限于单例效应。将这种残差校正框架扩展到高阶交互需要从树代理中有效地提取交互。 虽然存在提取 Shapley 交互指数（特定的基数概率交互）的算法, RegressionMSR is restricted to singleton effects. 3 Shapley 和 Banzhaf 相互作用的基于代理的近似Proxy-based Approximation of Shapley and Banzhaf Interactions

我们现在呈现We now present代理SHAPProxySHAP，通过分解为代理项和残差校正项来近似基数概率交互指数的通用框架。 给定预算, a general framework for approximating cardinal-probabilistic interaction indices via a decomposition into a proxy term and a residual correction term. Given a budget ofmm联盟，我们对集合进行采样coalitions, we sample a collection𝒯={T1,…,Tm}⊆2N\mathcal{T}=\{T_{1},\dots,T_{m}\}\subseteq 2^{N}并查询值函数and query the value functionν​(T)\nu(T)为所有人for allT∈𝒯T\in\mathcal{T}。 使用这些样本，我们拟合代理模型. Using these samples, we fit a proxy modelν^𝒯:2N→ℝ\hat{\nu}_{\mathcal{T}}:2^{N}\to\mathbb{R}近似底层游戏to approximate the underlying gameν\nu。 ProxySHAP 的关键观察是，通过基数概率交互指数的线性. The key observation underlying ProxySHAP is that, by linearity of cardinal-probabilistic interaction indices[14]，目标交互承认分解, the target interaction admits the decomposition

ϕSp​(ν)=ϕSp​(ν^𝒯)⏟Exact Proxy+ϕSp​(ν−ν^𝒯)⏟Residual.\displaystyle\phi^{p}_{S}(\nu)=\underbrace{\phi^{p}_{S}(\hat{\nu}_{\mathcal{T}})}_{\text{Exact Proxy}}+\underbrace{\phi^{p}_{S}(\nu-\hat{\nu}_{\mathcal{T}})}_{\text{Residual}}. (6)

这将整体近似问题分为两个部分：This separates the overall approximation problem into two components:(一)(i)建模问题，即代理的效果如何a modeling problem, namely how well the proxyν^𝒯\hat{\nu}_{\mathcal{T}}近似approximatesν\nu, 和, and(二)(ii)修正问题，即如何准确地从可用的联盟评估中估计剩余相互作用。a correction problem, namely, how accurately the residual interactions can be estimated from the available coalition evaluations.

这种观点使 ProxySHAP 成为This perspective makes ProxySHAP a框架framework而不是单一的固定估计器。 在概念层面上，代理类的唯一要求是可以有效地提取其基数概率交互。 学习代理本身是一个标准的监督回归问题，其中采样的联盟表示为二进制输入和相应的游戏值rather than a single fixed estimator. At a conceptual level, the only requirement for the proxy class is that its cardinal-probabilistic interactions can be efficiently extracted. Learning the proxy itself is a standard supervised regression problem, where the sampled coalitions are represented as binary inputs and the corresponding game valuesν​(T)\nu(T)作为目标。 因此，原则上，任何机器学习模型都可以充当代理，只要其交互保持易于处理。 此外，这种观点自然可以通过超参数优化来提高代理质量，如图所示serve as targets. Hence, in principle, any machine learning model can serve as a proxy, provided its interactions remain tractable. Moreover, this viewpoint naturally enables hyperparameter optimization to improve proxy quality, as shown inFigure˜5.

在这项工作中，我们研究了两个代理类。 首先，我们考虑具有交互特征的线性代理，它提供了一个简单且通常具有竞争力的基线。 其次，我们考虑基于树的代理，它构成了 ProxySHAP 的主要实例。 它们的吸引力在于它们比线性代理更具表现力，同时（正如我们在下一小节中所示）仍然允许精确的多项式时间基数概率交互提取。 这种精确的提取是获得比基于傅立叶的代理方法显着的运行时间改进的关键。In this work, we study two proxy classes. First, we consider a linear proxy with interaction features, which provides a simple and often competitive baseline. Second, we consider tree-based proxies, which form our main instantiation of ProxySHAP. Their appeal is that they are substantially more expressive than linear surrogates, while—as we show in the next subsection—still admitting exact polynomial-time cardinal-probabilistic interaction extraction. This exact extraction is the key to obtaining a substantial runtime improvement over Fourier-based proxy methods.

因此，只要交互基础保持足够小以能够可靠地拟合，线性代理就提供了 ProxySHAP 的简单有效的实例化。 然而，当值函数表现出很强的非线性，并且它们的参数数量随着交互阶数组合增长时，它们就会变得受到限制。 这使得它们对于大型企业来说越来越不切实际Thus, linear proxies provide a simple and effective instantiation of ProxySHAP whenever the interaction basis remains sufficiently small to be fitted reliably. Tree-based proxies offer a compelling alternative: they capture complex non-linear relationships while remaining applicable to large feature sets and high-order interactions. 我们评估所有 MSR 调整的质量We evaluate the quality of MSR adjustment across all2626基准 TabArenabenchmarked TabArena[13]数据集在datasets inFigure˜3;附录中提供了更多详细信息; further details are provided in AppendixD.7。我们的发现有三个方面。首先，对于成对交互近似，随着评估预算的增加，MSR 显着降低了 MSE。其次，这种好处随着玩家数量的增加而减弱，使得这种调整对于高维游戏来说不切实际。第三，对于高阶交互，即使预算很大，调整也可能会损害中型游戏的性能，这与在成对交互中观察到的更强劲的收益形成鲜明对比。. Our findings are threefold. First, for pairwise interaction approximation, MSR substantially reduces the MSE as the evaluation budget increases. Second, this benefit diminishes as the number of players grows, making the adjustment impractical for high-dimensional games. Third, for higher-order interactions, adjustments can already harm performance in medium-sized games, even with large budgets, in contrast to the more robust gains observed for pairwise interactions.

因此，虽然 MSR 调整对于一阶交互仍然有效，但它对高阶交互的好处更加微妙。它极大地提高了中小型游戏中二阶交互的近似质量，但除了成对交互之外，它主要对小型游戏有益。作为实用的经验法则，我们建议主要在低维设置中应用 MSR 调整Consequently, while MSR adjustment remains effective for first-order interactions, its benefit for higher-order interactions is more nuanced. It substantially improves approximation quality for second-order interactions in small- to medium-sized games, but beyond pairwise interactions, it is mainly beneficial for smaller games. As a practical rule of thumb, we recommend applying MSR adjustment primarily in low-dimensional settings withn<30n<30。对于较大的游戏，只有当抽样预算相对于显性方差项足够大时才应使用调整，即当. For larger games, adjustment should only be used when the sampling budget is sufficiently large relative to the dominant variance term, i.e., when|𝒯|≫nk−1|\mathcal{T}|\gg n^{k-1}根据订单进行交互for interactions up to orderkk，在我们的实验中，只有预算高于以上的中型游戏才会出现这种情况, which in our experiments occurs for medium-sized games only at budgets above10,00010{,}000.

5 结论Conclusion

我们提出了 ProxySHAP，这是一种有效的模型不可知近似方法，适用于广泛的基数概率交互指数。 ProxySHAP 的核心是以封闭形式从基于树的代理中提取任何基数概率​​交互索引，包括 Shapley 和 Banzhaf 变体。 值得注意的是，我们比基于傅立叶的提取实现了数量级的加速。 通过利用交互指数的线性，ProxySHAP 可以干净地分解为精确的代理项和基于 MSR 的残差校正。 根据我们对 MSR 的广泛经验评估和理论方差界限，我们建议应用残差校正We propose ProxySHAP, an efficient model-agnostic approximation method for the broad class of cardinal-probabilistic interaction indices. At its core, ProxySHAP extracts, in closed form, any cardinal-probabilistic interaction index, including Shapley and Banzhaf variants, from tree-based proxies. Notably, we achieve orders-of-magnitude speedups over Fourier-based extraction. By exploiting the linearity of interaction indices, ProxySHAP admits a clean decomposition into an exact proxy term and an MSR-based residual correction. Based on our extensive empirical evaluation and theoretical variance bound for MSR, we recommend applying the residual correction情境地situationally：用于订单交互: for interactions of orderkk，它在游戏中最有用, it is most useful in games withn<30n<30玩家或预算满足时players or when the budget satisfies|𝒯|≫nk−1|\mathcal{T}|\gg n^{k-1}。 根据经验，ProxySHAP 在广泛的基准测试中实现了强大的近似质量，在低预算和高预算情况下均优于 ProxySPEX 和 KernelSHAP-IQ，并且在应用于 CLIP 时优于 Pareto 主导的 FIxLIP 和 ProxySPEX。. Empirically, ProxySHAP achieves strong approximation quality across an extensive benchmark, outperforming ProxySPEX and KernelSHAP-IQ in both low- and high-budget regimes, and Pareto-dominating FIxLIP and ProxySPEX when applied to CLIP.

局限性和未来的工作。Limitations and future work.ProxySHAP 近似的质量直接取决于经过训练的代理。 我们证明了 HPO 极大地提高了 XGBoost 代理的性能，但会产生大量的计算开销。 在未来的工作中，我们的目标是探索其他代理类，包括它们的有效交互提取。 第二个开放方向涉及残差校正：虽然 MSR 原则上恢复了一致性，但其方差随着交互顺序而快速增长，限制了其在高维设置中的实际效益。 开发可更优雅地扩展的残差估计器仍然是一个重要的悬而未决的问题。 另一个扩展是广义值类The quality of ProxySHAP’s approximation depends directly on the trained proxy. We demonstrated that HPO substantially increases the performance of the XGBoost proxy, but incurs a large computational overhead. In future work, we aim to explore other proxy classes, including their efficient interaction extraction. A second open direction concerns the residual correction: while MSR restores consistency in principle, its variance grows rapidly with interaction order, limiting its practical benefit in high-dimensional settings. Developing residual estimators that scale more gracefully remains an important open problem. Another extension is the class of generalized values[39]捕获跨功能组的共同贡献that capture joint contributions across feature groups[15].

更广泛的影响。Broader impact.我们相信 ProxySHAP 可以帮助科学研究人员量化复杂系统中变量之间的非线性依赖性，例如在物理学中We believe ProxySHAP can empower scientific researchers in quantifying nonlinear dependencies between variables in complex systems, e.g. in physics[35]和材料科学and material sciences[5]。 我们为我们的算法提供高度可扩展的 C++ 实现，从而能够量化跨越大型数据集的数十亿个参数的基础模型中的交互。. We provide a highly scalable C++ implementation of our algorithm, enabling the quantification of interactions in foundation models spanning billions of parameters across large datasets.

我们首先推导出任意抽样分布下 MSR 估计量的一般方差恒等式We first derive a general variance identity for the MSR estimator under arbitrary sampling distributions inTheorem˜A.3。 然后，我们将这种恒等式专门用于比例抽样，最重要的是，利用沙普利交互指数的抽样。 后者的专业化产生了定理. We then specialize this identity to proportional sampling and, most importantly, to leverage sampling for the Shapley interaction index. The latter specialization yields Theorem3.3来自主要论文。 相应的下限如推论所示from the main paper. Corresponding lower bounds are shown in CorollaryA.7。 Banzhaf 相互作用指数的相应界限可以在推论中找到.
